name: Je-useuui Daeliin 1 Cha
source:
Young-un is an ordinary girl who has just finished high-school. She seems to be heading towards a promising future when suddenly she is visited by none other than Zeus himself, who in the form of golden rain, drags her to Olympus.

The only things Zeus gives her are strange glowing tattoos on her back and new burden to act as Zeus’s substitute. To return to her world, she must complete her job as the substitute of Zeus…

Olympus, where the present and the past are distorted into a chaotic concoction - Young-un’s perilous journey with gods and mythical creatures begins here!

[From the old The Substitute of Zeus Official Blog]
translation:
英恩是一个刚刚高中毕业的普通女孩。她似乎正在走向一个充满希望的未来，突然宙斯亲自拜访了她，他以金色的雨的形式将她拖到了奥林匹斯山。

宙斯给她的唯一东西是她背上奇怪的发光纹身和充当宙斯替身的新负担。为了回到自己的世界，她必须完成代替宙斯的工作……

奥林匹斯山，现在和过去被扭曲成混乱的混合物 - 英云与众神和神话生物的危险旅程从这里开始！

【摘自旧版《宙斯的替身》官方博客】
